name: Dewsbury Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Dewsbury Baptist Church. Open Tue 11am-2pm and Fri 10am-1pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Kirklees Council Allotments
short_description: Kirklees Council allotment sites in Dewsbury area
description: Council manages sites at Dewsbury and Ravensthorpe. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage.

name: Dewsbury Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Crow Nest Park
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Crow Nest Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Victorian park setting.
